I replied to Ilse in our DM. I confirmed their Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork cutoff is now 7 July and that I'll keep it between us.

My GBrain search on Quarrendon Freight Lines didn't find anything about a cutoff date, so nothing there disagrees with what Ilse told me. As they asked, I took no other action.
